notes: Basis: governmental funds are on a modified cash basis but presented as revenues/expenditures/fund balance, and the proprietary funds are accrual with a statement of cash flows, so basis = GAAP (fund balance roll-forward). Governmental lines use the Total column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (pages 21-24 of the report = trimmed pp 8-11). Loan Proceeds 7,684 is printed inside Total Revenue 497,438, so it is recorded in debt_proceeds (reported_totals.governmental.receipts includes debt_proceeds). Transfers: Total column shows transfers in 9,600 and out 0 (proprietary funds' 9,600 transfers out; the 42,400 eliminated in the Adjustments column). Roll-forward: 396,510 + 489,754 - 425,748 + 9,600 + 7,684 = 477,800. ending_cash = Cash and Cash Equivalents 442,402 on the governmental funds balance sheet total column (p7); Cash at County Treasurer 9,665 is a separate line. Business-type lines use the Totals column of the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position (p16-17); business-type receipts/disbursements totals are sums of printed subtotals (see computed). Check: 2,224,598 + 1,203,081 - 1,114,547 - 9,600 = 2,303,532. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (pp1-2); balances. The Budgetary Comparison Schedule (pp20-21) is cash basis, total primary government, mixing governmental and business-type funds, and its actuals differ from the GAAP statements; it is not recorded in detail (per-fund rule: per-fund lines from the fund statements replace the combined schedule; its printed expenditure total 1,782,543 includes transfers out split from spending lines). Fix pass (attempt 2): the budget schedule prints Transfers 52,000 (General 12,000 in + Street 40,000 in) with no transfer-out line; the outflows (General 40,000, Street 2,400 on p10, and Electric/Trash/Sewer/Water 2,400 each on p17 = 52,000 total) sit inside the spending lines on p21. Top-level transfers_in 9,600 / transfers_out 0 stay as the governmental funds statement Total column (42,400 eliminated in the Adjustments column). Re-trim (find_pages v8): gained the government-wide Statement of Activities (trimmed pp3-5; nothing added), the Schedule of Expenditures - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds (p22, funds x object, total 425,748) and the Electric statistical data schedule (p23, unaudited, KWH data; nothing added). Fix pass (attempt 4): governmental expenditure detail is the p22 per-fund object schedule (General, Street and Alley, City Hall, Park, Pool; Grants Fund all zero, omitted; zero-amount object lines omitted); it replaces the fund statement's function lines ('not itemized') and principal/interest lines for those funds, so nothing is double counted; the object lines per fund tie to each fund's printed Total Expenditures (General 137,312, Street and Alley 195,014, City Hall 14,779, Park 42,945, Pool 35,698 = 425,748). Capital Expenditures lines are category capital outlay labelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>' (function from the fund); the p22 Debt Service lines (Street 1,800 = 1,576 principal + 224 interest, Park 1,000 = 875 + 125 per p8) are one combined amount on this schedule. General Fund Public Safety 436 (p8) is not separated on p22. Fix pass (attempt 3): balance-sheet Due from Other Funds (governmental 25,733) and Due to Other Funds (business-type 25,733) are eliminated in the Adjustments column and the Total column prints 0 for both, so both lines are recorded as 0; asset lines sum to printed total assets 5,242,889 and liability lines to printed total liabilities 1,991,927. Read pages 1-23 of 23.
